cohort: The study included 148 singleton pregnant women diagnosed with preeclampsia who experienced preterm delivery.
finding: Female fetal sex and low placental growth factor (PlGF) were identified as significant predictors of perinatal death in preterm preeclampsia, with their predictive power only surpassed by early gestational age at birth.
gest_age: Babies included were from preterm deliveries, and gestational age at admission was a measured variable in the prediction model.
